scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm --workspace=api run build 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.audit:fix: npm audit fix --force && npm --workspace=frontend audit fix --force && npm --workspace=backend audit fix --force && npm --workspace=api audit fix --force
scripts.audit: npm audit && npm --workspace=frontend audit && npm --workspace=backend audit && npm --workspace=api audit
